rule: Stratify the 222-game June-September 2026 pool by total team errors (eT = away E + home E): A eT>=3, B eT==2, C eT<=1. Take the first k of each stratum by selection index, then trim to 24 games for the context budget.
rationale: The sample is ERROR-ENRICHED by intent and is NOT self-weighting. The per-stratum sampling fractions differ by a factor of ~19 (0.500 / 0.196 / 0.026), so any pool-representative rate requires the raking weights above; applying them reconstructs the pool mean of 1.113 team-errors/game as 1.258, the residual being sampling noise at n=24. The fitted objects model P(class | batted-ball features) WITHIN a play, which is far less distorted than the game-level error rate, but the 1.91% base rate quoted on the site is the SAMPLE rate, not the pool rate. An earlier version of this file claimed a uniform 0.5 fraction in every stratum and a uniform weight of 2.0; that was wrong and was removed on 2026-09-29.
verification: Every game's eT, official date and final score is independently re-checked against https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/game/{pk}/linescore; the ledger is data/verified_linescores.json and tests/test_pipeline.py fails if any of the 24 disagrees with the official record or with the stratum filed here.
